biological_material: primary human follicle dermal papilla cells, 2D culture

primary_prediction.meaning: the frozen disease-direction WNT/regeneration-loss projection should move toward the opposite/health-associated direction after minoxidil exposure

secondary_axes.ecm_structural_remodeling: no directional acceptance criterion at 48 h

acceptance.replication_requirement: primary direction should also be tested in a separate 3D HFDPC context before promotion
acceptance.caveat: same-lab cell-culture replication is not human clinical replication

claim_boundary: This tests whether a known pharmacologic input moves a frozen transcript projection in cultured HFDPCs. It does not establish clinical efficacy, a patient biomarker, recoverability, or a consciousness-mediated route.
